code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)\n    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    fg_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)\n    marker = fg_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]\n    pattern = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)\n               if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker]\n    if not pattern:\n        return [row[:] for row in grid]\n    min_r = min(r for r, c, v in pattern)\n    max_r = max(r for r, c, v in pattern)\n    min_c = min(c for r, c, v in pattern)\n    max_c = max(c for r, c, v in pattern)\n    anchor_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2\n    anchor_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r, c in marks:\n        out[r][c] = bg\n        for pr, pc, value in pattern:\n            rr, cc = r + pr - anchor_r, c + pc - anchor_c\n            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:\n                out[rr][cc] = value\n    return out\n'''
